11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager announces there is nothing to worry about, then demonstrates an elaborate way of stacking coconuts.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: "I have absolutely nothing to worry about," (subject) announces confidently. "I've done this a hundred times." (subject.He/She) is about to demonstrate an elaborate method of stacking coconuts. (friend) watches with considerable interest.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The first coconut balances perfectly. So does the second. The third rolls away, strikes a basket, and sends six more coconuts tumbling across the ground. (subject) watches the disaster unfold. "A hundred and one times," (subject.he/she) corrects.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) studies the coconuts and decides the stack needs a wider base. The demonstration proceeds without incident. (friend) looks faintly disappointed. "I thought something exciting was going to happen." "So did I," admits (subject).
